hypotheses.persona: Working professional who follows a regular weekday schedule but has different weekend routines
hypotheses.rationale: The consistent weekday pattern (departure 8:41-9:39 AM, return 6:11-7:59 PM) strongly supports a regular work schedule. Weekend observations show different activity patterns - later breakfast on Saturday (8:16 AM) and Sunday (8:51 AM), later dinner on Saturday (18:45) and Sunday (19:14), and evening relaxation activities with remote at 23:43 on Saturday and 20:00 on Sunday. Monday's breakfast at 8:30 aligns with weekday pattern resumption.

Could explain the weekday work pattern, but the consistency across four weekdays is more typical of a full-time professional than a student with classes. Weekend activities don't clearly support student patterns either.
